objective: Adapt the Elementor Implementation Toolkit Admin V0.2 frame-first plan into an Agentic Ops operational contract that can be inspected, initialized in overlay mode, validated, executed, snapshotted, exported, and handed off through the Agentic Ops MCP.
scope: Use the WordPress workspace as an Agentic Ops overlay target without replacing AGENTS.md.
Keep the Admin V0.2 source of truth, frame implementation plan, canonical icons, and QA evidence as the source inputs.
Use cms_wordpress_elementor_low_code as the primary preset and visual_front_end_first as the secondary validation preset.
Turn the first implementation slice into ordered phases, tasks, tests, decisions, and handoff context.
Limit code execution scope to the Elementor Implementation Toolkit admin UI/config state when implementation begins.
Use MCP validation before treating any plan, task, phase, test, or handoff as executable.
out_of_scope: Do not replace existing AGENTS.md instructions.
Do not initialize .agentic-ops/ automatically as part of this documentation adaptation.
Do not build runtime filtering, listing, grid rendering, or frontend token export in Admin V0.2.
Do not claim deep WooCommerce, Simple Budget, JetEngine, Elementor Pro, or Elementor Globals runtime integration until separately researched and implemented.
Do not use production WordPress access or destructive CLI flags.

Existing plugin admin code reuse must be inspected before changing source files.
Some frame details may be generated artifacts and must be corrected against the source-of-truth document.

The first slice does not create a listing/grid renderer.
Preview is controller-only unless a later task explicitly expands scope.

research_packets.update_policy: Recheck when implementation starts because WordPress and Elementor APIs can change.

research_packets.task_impact: May split TASK-005 if existing admin save behavior is more coupled than expected.

Existing plugin source path must be confirmed before implementation.

decisions.title: Use Agentic Ops overlay mode
decisions.summary: This workspace has AGENTS.md and no .agentic-ops/ yet, so the MCP path is overlay mode.
decisions.rationale: Overlay mode preserves existing repository instructions and keeps Agentic Ops removable.
evidence: mcp__agentic_ops__.inspect_workspace reported has_agentic_ops false and recommended_mode overlay.
risks: Root repository policy must accept .agentic-ops/ as an operational overlay.

decisions.title: Use CMS/WordPress/Elementor as primary preset
decisions.summary: The execution environment, safety boundaries, and compatibility risks are WordPress/Elementor concerns.
decisions.rationale: The visual frames are important, but the plugin must preserve WordPress admin behavior, saved options, nonces, capabilities, escaping, and Elementor Free compatibility.
alternatives_considered: Visual Front-End First as primary preset
risks: The plan must still enforce visual QA or it can drift into a generic settings screen.

decisions.title: Use Visual Front-End First as secondary validation preset
decisions.summary: Approved frames define visual success and require screenshot-based QA.
decisions.rationale: The implementation must match product-system frames, but visual matching is a validation layer under WordPress containment.
risks: Generated frames may contain inconsistent details that need source-of-truth decisions.

decisions.title: First code slice is Filter Preset admin only
decisions.summary: The first implementation slice proves the admin architecture without runtime filtering or integration modules.
decisions.rationale: A smaller slice creates reusable primitives and evidence before CPT/Integrations frames expand scope.
alternatives_considered: Build all frames in one pass
risks: Secondary frames may become stale if not promoted into subplans after the first slice.

decisions.title: Lock Admin V0.2 source hierarchy
decisions.summary: The source-of-truth document controls implementation decisions when generated frames or old planning notes disagree.
decisions.rationale: This prevents the next implementation agent from averaging inconsistent generated frames into a generic admin UI.
alternatives_considered: Use frame implementation plan as literal task list
Let each implementer reinterpret frame priority
risks: If the source hierarchy is bypassed, first-slice implementation can drift into unrelated secondary modules.

decisions.title: Lock frame classification for first slice
decisions.summary: Frames 16-24 and 26-27 define the first Filter Preset implementation target; frames 01-15 are secondary; frame 25 is reference-only; frame 28 is interaction reference only.
decisions.rationale: The first slice must prove one coherent Filter Preset architecture before CPT and Integrations frames expand scope.
risks: Secondary frames may look ready, but implementing them now would weaken QA and component reuse.

decisions.title: Freeze first-slice icon vocabulary
decisions.summary: The first implementation slice uses the 58 canonical WebP icons and non-asset primitives; no new icon generation is allowed before the first slice passes QA.
decisions.rationale: The old frame plan implies hundreds of one-off icon concepts, but the canonical manifest deliberately reduces that to a reusable vocabulary.
evidence: All 58 manifest icon paths were checked as present in the workspace.
risks: If generated icons resume too early, the implementation can accumulate asset drift and inconsistent visual language.

decisions.title: Lock Admin V0.2 runtime and preview boundary
decisions.summary: Admin V0.2 may render contracts and controller-only previews, but it must not implement or claim runtime filtering, listing/grid rendering, or deep integration adapters in the first slice.
decisions.rationale: The first slice is admin architecture and saved configuration, not frontend runtime behavior.
alternatives_considered: Build runtime filtering during first slice
Add listing/grid preview to the modal
risks: Preview UI can accidentally imply frontend runtime behavior exists.

decisions.title: Require frame-driven QA for primary frame closure
decisions.summary: A visual task closes only with source-frame reference, browser screenshots, console result, and frame-drift notes.
decisions.rationale: The success standard is recognizably matching the approved product system, not merely passing lint or rendering HTML.
alternatives_considered: Close visual tasks with lint only
Defer screenshots to a later pass
risks: Local WordPress or Playwright setup can block visual QA; if blocked, the task must report the blocker instead of closing.

decisions.title: Defer secondary frames into bounded backlog
decisions.summary: CPT Manager and Integrations frames remain future Agentic Ops subplans until the Filter Preset first slice passes QA.
decisions.rationale: The implementation needs one stable shared admin architecture before adding more module families.
alternatives_considered: Mix CPT and Integrations frames into first-slice tasks
risks: Future module plans must still revalidate whether runtime adapters are in scope.

tests.objective: Confirm Agentic Ops initialization is non-destructive and overlay-only.
preconditions: User has accepted root .agentic-ops/ overlay if needed.
git status is recorded.
steps: Run aops init --non-destructive --overlay --preset cms_wordpress_elementor_low_code.
Run mcp__agentic_ops__.inspect_workspace.
Run git status --short --branch.
tests.expected_result: Only .agentic-ops/ overlay files appear and existing instructions remain unchanged.
pass_criteria: AGENTS.md unchanged
recommended_mode is overlay or has_agentic_ops is true
no unexpected root files are created

tests.objective: Preserve WordPress admin safety while rebuilding UI primitives.
preconditions: Plugin source has been inspected.
Implementation edits exist.
steps: Inspect save handlers for nonce and capability checks.
Inspect render output for escaping.
Run PHP lint on changed PHP files.
Activate/open plugin admin locally.
tests.expected_result: Existing safety behavior remains intact and admin page opens without fatal errors.
pass_criteria: nonces present on state-changing actions
capability checks present
user-controlled output escaped
PHP lint passes

no page-level horizontal overflow

analysis_reports.summary: The old plan is broad, so Agentic Ops should treat Filter Preset as the first slice and move CPT/Integrations into future subplans.
findings: The frame plan contains first-slice frames, secondary frames, reference-only frames, and interaction references.
Trying to implement all frames in one batch would break budget and validation quality.
MCP overlay mode introduces a root-level artifact that should be accepted intentionally.
recommendations: Initialize Agentic Ops overlay only after accepting the root overlay.
Validate this plan before generating implementation tasks.
Do not start plugin source edits before source contract consolidation is complete.

handoff.current_state: Agentic Ops MCP adaptation documented; .agentic-ops/ overlay not initialized by this artifact.
handoff.objective: Continue by initializing overlay mode, importing/validating this plan, then executing the Filter Preset first slice.
decisions_made: Visual Front-End First is secondary validation preset.
First code slice is Filter Preset admin only.
pending_decisions: Approve root .agentic-ops/ overlay creation if strict root containment remains a concern.
Confirm current local Elementor/WordPress versions before code edits.
Confirm existing plugin source path and reusable code before implementation.
risks: Root .agentic-ops/ overlay may need explicit acceptance because AGENTS.md says nothing else should live in repository root.
Visual frames can contain generated inconsistencies.
Implementation can drift into runtime adapters if secondary frames are not deferred.
next_steps: If accepted, initialize overlay with aops init --non-destructive --overlay --preset cms_wordpress_elementor_low_code.
Import this plan into .agentic-ops/ and validate phases/tasks/tests before code edits.
Start TASK-004 before touching plugin source.
do_not_reopen: Do not reopen the decision that WordPress admin chrome remains visible.
Do not reopen the first-slice boundary unless the user explicitly changes scope.
Do not turn preview into a grid/listing renderer.
Do not treat frame 25 as a screen or frame 28 as the default shell.
handoff.how_to_continue_briefing_user: Report MCP validation status, root overlay impact, and the next executable task.
handoff.first_recommended_mcp_prompt: Inspect this WordPress workspace, validate docs/implementation-toolkit/admin-v0.2-agentic-ops-plan.json, then prepare overlay import without overwriting AGENTS.md.
